    "Cost-effective solution for a small team"

    "Time tracking interface can be clunky and not always intuitive",
    "Lacked specific features for healthcare-related time tracking",

  "overall_experience": "The Office Manager found Zoho CRM to be a reasonably good value, especially for having integrated time tracking. While the consolidation of data was beneficial, the time tracking functionality itself was occasionally cumbersome and not perfectly tailored to the specific needs of a healthcare environment. Overall, it served its purpose but presented some usability challenges for daily administrative tasks."
